The error is clear: each `edge` declaration needs an **operator** — one of `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`. 

For a topology diagram showing network links, the undirected operator `--` is appropriate, since these are bidirectional connections.

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub"

edge access1 -- branch
edge access2 -- branch
edge branch -- hubprimary class=primary
edge branch -- hubbackup class=backup

class primary "Primary WAN Link"
class backup "Backup WAN Link"
```

The only changes are adding `--` to each of the four edge statements (lines 11–14). This specifies bidirectional links appropriate for a network topology, and all four errors should now resolve.
